subject: general
question: Which of the following texts lays down minute details of the administrative and military organization during the Mauryan empire?
solution:
The Correct Answer is** Arthashastra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chief source of information regarding administration under the Mauryan Empire is Chanakya’s work, **Arthashastra.**
 
• **Megasthenes** also gives some information in his book **Indika**.
 
• It is mentioned by Pliny in his account that **Chandragupta Maurya** maintained about 9000 elephants, 30000 cavalry and 600000 foot soldiers.
 
• It is even mentioned that there were about 800 chariots during the** Mauryan administration**.
 
• **Mauryans' military** was three times the strength of Nandas.
 
• The** Arthashastra **lays down minute details of administrative and military organisation.
 
• This is what it says about how to capture elephants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brihat Samhita** is a noted work of Varahamihira.

 
 
• Varahamihira wrote the Brihat Samhita. It is an important encyclopedic text in Sanskrit.
 
• This text exists in many Indian scripts and is preserved in Hindu, Jain, and Buddhist temples and monasteries.
 
 
 
• **Nitisara** ( transl. Essence of Statesmanship) or the Nitisara of Kamandaki,
 
 
• It is an ancient Indian treatise on politics and statecraft.
 
• It was authored by Kamandaka, also known as Kamandaki or Kamandakiya, who was a disciple of Chanakya.
 
 
 
• The **Shulba Sutras** are part of the larger corpus of texts called the Shrauta Sutras, considered to be appendices to the Vedas.
 
 
• They are the only sources of knowledge of Indian mathematics from the Vedic period.
 
• Unique fire-altar shapes were associated with unique gifts from the Gods.
